question: how many principals did aims ttp reach in noun division
answer: 85 Principals of 76 secondary schools in Noun Division, West Region, at an awareness seminar on 29 December 2020.
evidence: AIMS TTP closed the year 2020 by creating awareness on new methods of teaching Mathematics during its 8th Principals’ Awareness seminar attended by 85 Principals of 76 Secondary schools in Noun Division
